layers.note: A tufted grass of the herb layer.

moisture.note: Wet meadows, marsh edges and streambanks, and moist open ground; not dry sites.

heat_load.note: Indifferent to aspect wherever it is wet enough.

elevation_m.note: From sea level to alpine meadows.

max_slope_deg.note: Mostly level or gently sloping wet ground.

shade_tolerance.note: Needs open or lightly shaded ground.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in western Washington lowland forests; not yet checked against Silvics of North America (Burns and Honkala, 1990) or the Fire Effects Information System, both public-domain USDA Forest Service works.
